changed.title: For every n at least 3, an n by n graph with an AND/OR circuit of s gates has a complement with one of at most s + 2n - 4 gates, fan-in two
changed.statement: ∀ (n s : ℕ) (G : Fin n → Fin n → Bool), 3 ≤ n → (∃ C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit, PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.Monotone2 C ∧ PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.ReadsBack (n + n) C ∧ C.size ≤ s ∧ PEqualNP.Represents.Represents G C) → ∃ D : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit, PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.Monotone2 D ∧ PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.ReadsBack (n + n) D ∧ D.size ≤ s + 2 * n - 4 ∧ PEqualNP.Represents.Represents (fun u v => !(G u v)) D
changed.unlocks: a statement about NOT gates with no NOT gate in it: it bounds what one NOT gate at the top of a circuit can save
changed.context: A conjecture; we hold no argument. The unit beside it on unions of complete pieces gives it for those graphs; a proof must handle a connected graph with a connected complement, where no classes exist. Computed, not checked: at side 4 every class with both costs computed differs by at most 4 (305 pairs, two seats' code); at side 5 the matching against the crown sits exactly on it. It fails at n = 2, hence n from 3. The opposite unit stands beside it. A companion cannot exist as a unit: the statement is about every graph of its kind. Size: hours, if an argument exists.

changed.title: Known moment estimate rebuilt for signed first-order Walsh coefficients on a subset of the binary cube
changed.statement:
∀ (k m : ℕ), 0 < m →
  let N := 2^k
  ∀ (S : Finset (Fin N)) (b : Fin N → Bool),
    let v := fun (j : Fin k) =>
      ∑ x ∈ S, if xor (b x) (x.val.testBit j.val) then (-1 : ℝ) else 1
    let energy := ∑ j : Fin k, (v j)^2
    energy^m ≤ (N : ℝ) * (S.card : ℝ)^(2*m-1) * (∏ j ∈ Finset.range m, (2*(j:ℝ)+1))
changed.unlocks: bounds the signed first-level Walsh energy of a subset using its density and an explicit even moment
changed.context: L is the signed sum over S of the linear form with coefficients v. Apply the finite power-mean bound at exponent 2m, then extend the even-power sum to the whole cube. In its expansion only tuples with every index repeated evenly survive. Each admits a pairing of equal indices and has nonnegative coefficient. Each pairing sums to L^m, and there are (2m-1)!! pairings. Cancel L^m when positive. Zero energy is immediate.

Each pairing sums to L^m, and there are (2m-1)!! pairings. Cancel L^m when positive. Zero energy is immediate.

changed.title: Fixing a degree-two vertex v of a graph with no 4-cycle, where G - v and G - N[v] keep an edge, saves at least three gates at false or at least four at true
changed.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (E : List (Fin n × Fin n)) (v u w : Fin n) (C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit), (∀ e ∈ E, e.1 ≠ e.2) → (∀ a b c d : Fin n, a ≠ c → b ≠ d → ((a, b) ∈ E ∨ (b, a) ∈ E) → ((b, c) ∈ E ∨ (c, b) ∈ E) → ((c, d) ∈ E ∨ (d, c) ∈ E) → ((d, a) ∈ E ∨ (a, d) ∈ E) → False) → u ≠ w → ((v, u) ∈ E ∨ (u, v) ∈ E) → ((v, w) ∈ E ∨ (w, v) ∈ E) → (∀ z : Fin n, ((v, z) ∈ E ∨ (z, v) ∈ E) → z = u ∨ z = w) → (∃ e ∈ E, e.1 ≠ v ∧ e.2 ≠ v) → (∃ e ∈ E, e.1 ≠ v ∧ e.2 ≠ v ∧ e.1 ≠ u ∧ e.2 ≠ u ∧ e.1 ≠ w ∧ e.2 ≠ w) → PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.FanInTwo C → (∀ x : Fin n → Bool, C.eval (List.ofFn x) = E.any (fun e => x e.1 && x e.2)) → (∃ D : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit, PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.FanInTwo D ∧ D.size + 3 ≤ C.size ∧ ∀ x : Fin n → Bool, D.eval (List.ofFn x) = E.any (fun e => Function.update x v false e.1 && Function.update x v false e.2)) ∨ (∃ D : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit, PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.FanInTwo D ∧ D.size + 4 ≤ C.size ∧ ∀ x : Fin n → Bool, D.eval (List.ofFn x) = E.any (fun e => Function.update x v true e.1 && Function.update x v true e.2))

changed.title: Sharp agreement after adaptive parity queries for the parity of any mask of one-round cyclic outputs
changed.statement:
∀ (k : ℕ) (hk : 0 < k), k % 3 ≠ 0 →
  let F := ZMod 2
  let W := Fin k → F
  let D := W →ₗ[F] F
  let ix := fun z : ℕ => (⟨z % k, Nat.mod_lt _ hk⟩ : Fin k)
  let rot := fun (q : ℕ) (x : W) (i : Fin k) => x (ix (i.val + k - q % k))
  ∀ (spacing s t : ℕ) (name c : W) (S : Finset (Fin k)) (d : ℕ),
    let out := fun (x : W) (i : Fin k) =>
      let z := rot s x + name
      let y := fun j : Fin k =>
        z j + z (ix (j.val + spacing)) + z (ix (j.val + k - spacing % k))
      y i + (1 + y (ix (i.val + 1))) * y (ix (i.val + 2)) + rot t x i + c i
    let mu := (S.powerset.filter (fun E => ∀ i ∈ E, ix (i.val + 1) ∉ E)).sup Finset.card
    let run := fun (ask : Fin d → ℕ → D) (x : W) =>
      (List.finRange d).foldl (fun h j =>
        2 * h + (if ask j h x = 0 then 0 else 1)) (0 : ℕ)
    let p := if S = Finset.univ ∧ k % 2 = 0 then mu - 1 else mu
    let cap := (2 ^ k + 2 ^ (k - (p - d))) / 2
    let hits := fun (ask : Fin d → ℕ → D) (pred : ℕ → D) (bias : ℕ → F) =>
      ((Finset.univ : Finset W).filter (fun x =>
        (∑ i ∈ S, out x i) = pred (run ask x) x + bias (run ask x))).card
    (∀ ask pred bias, hits ask pred bias ≤ cap) ∧
      (∃ ask pred bias, hits ask pred bias = cap)
changed.unlocks: computes the maximum agreement for predicting a masked physical round after any given number of adaptive raw-key parity questions
changed.context: In the invertible mixed coordinates the polar form is the selected-edge adjacency matrix mod two. A path of l edges has rank twice ceil(l/2). The full cycle kernel is period two, of dimension one at odd width and two at even width. A repeated edge at width two cancels and a loop has zero polar. A leaf of codimension at most d loses at most 2d polar rank. the quadratic Walsh formula bounds its agreement. In symplectic coordinates query one factor of each of min(d,p) pairs, then use a best affine readout.

In symplectic coordinates query one factor of each of min(d,p) pairs, then use a best affine readout.

changed.title: Minimally unsatisfiable hidden clauses characterize exact width and cost budgets for an OR of disjoint conjunctions
changed.statement:
∀ (n m hiddenCount W K : ℕ), 0 < n → 0 < m → ∀ price : ℕ → ℕ, (∀ lo hi, lo ≤ hi → price lo ≤ price hi) →
  let Raw := Fin m × Fin n
  let Cl := PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.Clause (Sum Raw (Fin hiddenCount))
  let Hidden := PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.Clause (Fin hiddenCount)
  let enc := fun F : Finset Cl => ∀ x : Raw → Bool,
    (∃ j : Fin m, ∀ i : Fin n, x (j,i) = true) ↔
      ∃ z : Fin hiddenCount → Bool, PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.Satisfies (Sum.elim x z) (↑F : Set _)
  let consistent := fun U : Finset Hidden =>
    ∃ z : Fin hiddenCount → Bool, PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.Satisfies z (↑U : Set _)
  (∃ F : Finset Cl, enc F ∧ (∀ C ∈ F, C.card ≤ W) ∧
    (∑ C ∈ F, price C.card) ≤ K) ↔
  ∃ (U : Finset Hidden) (g : Hidden → ℕ),
    ¬ consistent U ∧ (∀ H ∈ U, consistent (U.erase H)) ∧
    (∑ H ∈ U, g H) = m ∧ (∀ H ∈ U, H.card + g H ≤ W) ∧
    (∑ H ∈ U, n^(g H) * price (H.card + g H)) ≤ K
changed.unlocks: Transforms a total-width encoding problem into a finite optimization over minimally unsatisfiable clauses on its hidden variables.
changed.context: Miss one uniform input in each block. Project the surviving false-input clauses to hidden bits and choose a minimal unsatisfiable subformula, with one original clause per member. Every missing input repairs the table and must occur positively in a chosen clause. Assign blocks to these clauses. A clause with u positive inputs survives with probability at most n^(-u), so averaging pays for the assigned groups. Conversely expand each hidden clause by all choices of one input per assigned block.

changed.title: Bounding total clause width forces exponentially many hidden bits for full cyclic window feasibility
changed.statement:
∀ (n w : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n),
  let Pat := Fin (w+1) → Bool
  let Raw := Fin n × Pat
  let accepts := fun T : Raw → Bool => ∃ x : Fin n → Bool, ∀ i : Fin n,
    T (i, fun j : Fin (w+1) => x ⟨(i.val+j.val)%n, Nat.mod_lt _ hn⟩) = true
  let enc := fun (a W : ℕ)
      (F : Finset (PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.Clause (Sum Raw (Fin a)))) =>
    (∀ C ∈ F, C.card ≤ W) ∧ ∀ T : Raw → Bool,
      accepts T ↔ ∃ z : Fin a → Bool,
        PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.Satisfies (Sum.elim T z) (↑F : Set _)
  let d := if n ≤ w+1 then n else w
  ((∃ a F, enc a 2 F) ↔ (n = 1 ∨ w = 0)) ∧
  ∀ k : ℕ, 2 ≤ k →
    (∀ a F, enc a (k+1) F →
      2^d ≤ ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k+1), (k+1-j) * Nat.choose a j) ∧
    ∃ a F, enc a (k+1) F ∧
      a ≤ (if n ≤ w+1 then 2*k*2^((n+k-1)/k)
           else n + 2*n*2^((w+1+k-1)/k))
changed.unlocks: Determines the exponential rate of the hidden-bit cost of CNFs of each fixed total width at least three for full cyclic windows.
changed.context: Restrict permissions to disjoint word tracks. In a minimal rejecting hidden core, each clause has a private falsifying assignment. Indicators of clauses of width at most j are independent multilinear functions of degree at most j. Sum their dimension bounds to bound the available raw literals. For the upper bound select word chunks by indicators, splitting long ORs into ternary clauses. One guard per chunk checks each required permission. Three distinct one-row repairs obstruct width two by majority.

Three distinct one-row repairs obstruct width two by majority.

changed.title: A matching of a coordinate selector attains a logarithmic improvement below one-quarter error with only paired OR signals
changed.statement:
∀ (k a c : ℕ), 2 ≤ a → 2^a ≤ k → c < a →
  let N := 2^k
  let r := 2^a
  let b := 2^c
  let m := 2^(a-1-c)
  let Z := 2^(r/2)
  let hit := Z - (2^b-2)^m
  let base := fun (x y : Fin N) => x.val.testBit (y.val % r)
  ∃ (π : Equiv.Perm (Fin N)) (flip : Fin N → Bool),
    let errors := fun (G : Fin N → Fin N → Bool) (decode : Finset (Fin N) → Bool) =>
      (Finset.univ.filter (fun z : Fin N × Fin N =>
        decode ({z.1,z.2} : Finset (Fin N)) ≠ xor (G z.1 (π z.2)) (flip z.1))).card
    let cost := errors base
    ∃ best : Finset (Fin N) → Bool,
      (∀ other : Finset (Fin N) → Bool, cost best ≤ cost other) ∧
      8*r*Z^2*cost best + b*N^2*hit^2 = 2*r*Z^2*N^2 ∧
      (2*b ≤ a → a < 4*b → 128*r*cost best + a*N^2 ≤ 32*r*N^2) ∧
      ∀ (A B : Finset (Fin N)) (T : Fin N → Fin N → Bool),
        (∀ x ∉ A, ∀ y ∉ B, T x y = base x y) →
        errors T best + (N-A.card)*(N-B.card) ≤ cost best + N^2
changed.unlocks: Determines the order of the finite gap below one-quarter error when the selector matching is optimized, by pairing this construction with the all-matching moment floor.
changed.context: Split r/2 active bits into b-bit blocks. Inactive bits give a bank, start and offset. In bank zero take the first constant block cyclically or the start on failure. Switch by its common bit on success and zero otherwise. In bank one select a uniform inactive label and switch by the XOR of two active bits. Each group has N/r rows. The signed matrix has zero inactive rows and active entries (N/r)H/Z inside blocks, zero between blocks. The trace of its square counts swap agreements minus disagreements. Each discordant unordered pair costs one error.

changed.statement: ∃ π : List (PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.LinClause (Fin 4 × Fin 3)), PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.IsLinRefutation (PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.PHP 4 3) π ∧ π.length ≤ 55
changed.unlocks: one entry on the least length of a refutation of a small pigeonhole formula in resolution over linear equations modulo two: exact proof sizes in small, the ground for running proof search exactly

changed.title: Largest union of translated boxes and the exact loss from a repeated forbidden symbol
changed.statement:
∀ (q m L : Nat), 0 < q → L ≤ q →
  let occ := fun (alphabet labels width : Nat) =>
    ((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin width → Fin alphabet)).filter (fun word =>
      ∀ a : Fin labels, ∃ i, (word i).val = a.val)).card
  let best := q^m - occ q L m
  let Menu := Fin m → Fin L → Fin q
  let hit := fun (menu : Menu) =>
    ((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin m → Fin q)).filter (fun input =>
      ∃ a, ∀ i, input i ≠ menu i a)).card
  let distinct := fun (table : Menu) => ∀ i, Function.Injective (table i)
  (∀ table : Menu, hit table ≤ best) ∧
  (∀ table : Menu, distinct table → hit table = best) ∧
  (∃ table : Menu, distinct table) ∧
  (3 ≤ q → 2 ≤ L → L-1 ≤ m →
    let gap := occ (q-2) (L-2) (m-1)
    0 < gap ∧
    (∀ table : Menu, ¬ distinct table → hit table + gap ≤ best) ∧
    ∃ table : Menu, ¬ distinct table ∧ hit table + gap = best)
changed.unlocks: Counts the maximum union of short translation lists and the exact loss caused by a repeated symbol.
changed.context: Fix all other inputs. If at least two labels survive, assigning distinct forbidden symbols in this column covers all q choices. With zero or one survivor its count is fixed. Make all columns injective, keeping a colliding column for last. A colliding pair loses one choice whenever exactly that pair survives elsewhere. Outside assignments of this kind avoid both symbols and see each remaining label, giving O(q-2,L-2,m-1). Merging just one pair in one otherwise injective column attains the loss.
